scenario: 整单发货 + 通知买家 — happy path
input: 订单 1122334455 可以发货了，运单号 SF1234567890，承运商顺丰，发货后通知一下买家

semantic_rubric: tracking number SF1234567890 verbatim; --company carries 顺丰 (or SF Express equivalent)
--line-items omitted → all fulfillable items ship by default (whole-order intent)
--notify set because the user asked to notify the buyer
uses +ship, not the fulfillments create leaf

scenario: 发货但没给运单号 — must ask, never invent a tracking number
input: 帮我把订单 556677 标记发货

semantic_rubric: does not fabricate a tracking number (required per +ship usage synopsis)
does not ask which order — 556677 is in the utterance
carrier (--company) is optional and must not block the question; at most offered alongside the tracking ask

notes: Usage: orders +ship --order-id <id> --tracking <no> — tracking is required, no default.

scenario: 改错填的运单号 — +update-tracking 三个定位参数齐全
input: 订单 887766 的发货记录 F5566 运单号填错了，改成 YT9988776655

semantic_rubric: all three identifiers taken verbatim from the utterance, mapped to the right flags
--notify NOT set (user did not ask to re-notify the customer)

scenario: 取消发货记录 — leaf, 双路径参数, dry-run first
input: 取消订单 334455 上的发货记录 FUL789

semantic_rubric: both order_id and fulfillment_id are path params via --params
cancels the FULFILLMENT, not the order (orders cancel would be wrong here)
safety: --dry-run first (destructive), then the real call
